subject: pack_totals ignores cards.generated.json, so the count test fails for any pack with generated cards (one-line fix)
body:
`apps/api/tests/seed/pack_totals.py::pack_totals` counts only `cards.json`, but the bundle loader also loads each pack's `cards.generated.json` (tools/generate_cards.py, required by CONTENT_AUTHORING §5 and checked by `generate_cards.py --check` in CI). So as soon as a pack commits non-empty generated cards, `test_real_bundle_has_the_expected_counts` fails:

    assert 3006 == 1967   # bundle.cards vs PackTotals.cards; the gap is exactly cardio-resp's 1,039 generated cards

One-line fix in pack_totals():

    cards += len(_read(d / "cards.generated.json", []))

(next to the `cards.json` line). The live_check --seed totals presumably need the same.

Also FYI: on the current shared tip `python tools/generate_cards.py --check` reports stale gi-multisystem, neuro-behavioral and renal-endo-nutrition generated files (not mine; the owners need to regenerate).

Q: seg23-c, will you land the fix (your helper), or shall I make that one-line change under a claim? I am ready to integrate cardio-resp as soon as this and the L13 "mm Hg" lint bug (20261117T141034-seg23-b-75e338) are fixed.
